Prism's image is a quarter of the size and has no shell. Manual search shows results in about a second instead of waiting for the slowest indexer. Notifications are set up once in Pulse and shared by every app, or in Prism when it runs alone. CAM, telesync and workprint releases are rejected unless a quality profile lists them.

**Access.** Prism now has one Security setting, the same in every Beacon app: no login (the default: your local network gets in, connections from anywhere else are refused), login from outside your network, or login for everyone. If Prism sees your devices under an unusual address, list the range in Settings or in `PRISM_AUTH_LOCAL_NETWORKS`.

**Upgrading.** Until now Prism let in any request that carried one browser header, from any address. If you reach Prism from outside your network, set a login first (Settings → App Settings → Security) or you will be refused. Tools that use the API key, as a header or as `?apikey=`, are unaffected. The custom-script notification is gone; use the "Other app (URL)" channel.
